title: Analysis of the charge generation and recombination processes in the PM6:Y6 organic solar cell
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,841-852
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03815K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Saied Md Pratik, Grit Kupgan, Jean-Luc Brédas, Veaceslav Coropceanu
This work gives a comprehensive description of the fundamental electronic processes taking place in the active layer of PM6:Y6 solar cells. It also points to the role of triplet states, excimer-like states, and defect states in device performance.
